summary: Behavior change: clear() (also the Clear button) while a request runs now stops that request; its answer is neither shown nor stored and nothing of it is recorded. Before, the answer landed in the emptied chat.
howTo: Nothing to do with useVercelAiChatTransport or the LangGraph transport. A custom ChatTransport is now stopped (stop()) when the chat is cleared during a run; until its status leaves submitted/streaming the chat stays busy and shows nothing of that run, then the provider empties the transport's messages (setMessages([])). A transport whose stop() does not end the request keeps the chat busy until its run ends. Apps that cleared during a run to keep the answer apart (or tests that expect the answer after clear()) stop relying on it. See docs/concepts.md, Turn outcomes.
